home.signInPrompt: Sign in to sell crops or place orders.
home.heroTitle: Which crop are you looking for today?
home.generalInfo: You can browse the platform. To sell or buy crops, apply for a farmer or buyer account. An administrator will verify you.
home.farmerText: Sell your crops directly to approved buyers. Needs your farmer card.
home.buyerText: Wholesaler, retailer, restaurant or hotel. Source crops directly from verified farmers.
home.approvedText: You can now use all features for your role.
home.comingSoon: More features (listings, chat, orders) are coming in the next modules.
home.suspended: Your account is suspended. You cannot start new activity.
home.completeProfile: Add your mobile number and addresses

location.noUpazilaData: Upazila data for this district is not added yet. Please choose another district for now.

apply.resubmitHint: Please fix what the administrator asked for, then submit again.
apply.cardKept: Leave empty to keep the number you already sent.
apply.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5 MB. Only administrators can see it.

profile.title: My profile
profile.mobileHint: Used for pickup and delivery contact. It is not verified by SMS.
profile.label: Name of address

admin.name: Name
admin.auditNote: Every time you view the number or photo, it is recorded in the audit log.

browse.searchPlaceholder: Search crops, e.g. rice, potato, ধান

listing.gradeByFarmer: {{grade}}, given by the farmer (not checked by HarvestX)
listing.contactNote: Phone numbers and e-mail addresses are never shown. Buying and chatting arrive in the next modules.
listing.notVisible: Only you and the administrators can see this listing.

myListings.title: My listings
myListings.confirmArchive: Archive this listing? Buyers will no longer see it.

listingForm.gradeHint: HarvestX does not check the grade. Buyers see that it comes from you.
listingForm.reviewWarning: This listing is public. If you change the crop, location, quantity, price or other important details, it goes back to review and is hidden until an administrator approves it again.
listingForm.archived: This listing is archived and cannot be changed.
listingForm.saveFirst: Save the draft first, then you can add photos.
listingForm.photosHint: Add 1 to 6 clear photos of the crop. Taking a photo with the camera saves the time and your location with it.
listingForm.maxPhotos: You can add at most 6 photos.
listingForm.rejectedPhoto: This photo was rejected by an administrator
listingForm.aiNote: The automatic photo check is only a helper. It is not proof of quality, and an administrator makes the final decision.
listingForm.submitHint: When the details and photos are ready, send the listing for review. At least one photo is needed.
listingForm.waitUploads: Wait for the photos to finish uploading, or remove the failed ones.
listingForm.sentForReview: Sent for review. You will see the result here.
listingForm.waitingReview: Your listing is waiting for an administrator.

adminCatalog.noFlagged: No photos are waiting for review.
adminCatalog.aliasesHint: Separate with commas, e.g. brinjal, begun
adminCatalog.rejected: Listing rejected. The farmer can see the reason.
adminCatalog.photoRejected: Photo rejected. The listing went back to the farmer.
adminCatalog.takedownHint: Hides the listing from buyers. The farmer sees the reason and can fix it.

prices.title: Market prices
prices.note: Retail prices collected by HarvestX. They are a guide, not an offer.
prices.validityHint: If you leave "valid until" empty, the price is shown for 7 days. Only one price per crop, market and day is allowed.
prices.expireReason: Why is this price no longer valid?
